request.description:
Returns all product categories, used to populate the Shop dropdown, the homepage top-rated section, and the category tiles on the Shop page.

Response 200:
[{"id":2,"code":"k:ayakkabi","title":"Ayakkabı","img":"<url>","rating":4.9,"gender":"k"}, ...]

gender is "k" (kadın) or "e" (erkek). Category links use the pattern /shop/:gender/:categoryName/:categoryId where gender is spelled out (kadin/erkek) and categoryName is the part of `code` after the colon, e.g. id 2 -> /shop/kadin/ayakkabi/2.

Returns a page of products, used to populate the Shop page grid.

Response 200:
{"total":587,"products":[{"id":2,"name":"Siyah %100 Pamuk","description":"...","price":145.99,"stock":84,"store_id":1,"category_id":1,"rating":0.35,"sell_count":923,"images":[{"url":"<cdn url>","index":0}]}, ...]}

Defaults to 25 products. Supports ?limit=&offset=&filter=&category=&sort= query params.

Returns a single product, used to populate the Product Detail Page.

Response 200:
{"id":322,"name":"Gri Regular Astar","description":"...","price":461.99,"stock":140,"store_id":1,"category_id":3,"rating":3.64,"sell_count":281,"images":[{"url":"<cdn url>","index":0}]}

An invalid/unknown id returns 500.

Same endpoint as Get Products, showing how category/filter/sort combine. All three params are optional and independent - whichever ones are present are applied together.

sort accepts: price:asc, price:desc, rating:asc, rating:desc.

On the Shop page, changing any one of category (via URL), filter (text input) or sort (select) re-fetches with all currently-set params kept.

Pagination via limit/offset. limit defaults to 25 (product count per page), offset is how many products to skip.

Page 1: no offset (or offset=0)
Page 2: offset=25 (limit * (page-1))
Page 3: offset=50

On the Shop page, clicking a page number recomputes offset and re-fetches, keeping any active category/filter/sort.

Returns the list of available roles used to populate the role selection box on the Sign Up form.

Response 200:
[{"id":1,"name":"Yönetici","code":"admin"},{"id":2,"name":"Mağaza","code":"store"},{"id":3,"name":"Müşteri","code":"customer"}]

Registers a Store user (role_id: 2). Requires the nested `store` object with name, phone, tax_no and bank_account.

Response 201:
{"message":"User created. Check your email for activation instructions."}

Note: sending an extra field, a renamed field, or a missing required field returns a backend error.
